description: Eligible multi-model Beast Units may designate one Alpha, using the existing +25 Point package. Its +2 maximum Wounds apply only to the chosen Model; a single Unit may contain only one Alpha. Alpha granted Unit-wide effects end if that Model is removed. Printed Impact bonuses add to normal highest-die Charge Impact.
notes: Some ordinary Beast Units can be upgraded to include an unusually large or dominant member of their species.

alphaPackage.name: Alpha
procedure: Choose one Model in an eligible multi-model Beast Unit.

alphaTraits.name: Pack Leader
alphaTraits.description: While this Model remains alive, the Unit's Melee Attacks gain Accurate 1.

alphaTraits.name: Savage Alpha
alphaTraits.description: The Alpha Model's primary Engagement weapon gains +1 Attack.

alphaTraits.name: Charging Alpha
alphaTraits.description: While the Alpha remains alive, the Unit gains Impact 1. If it already has Impact X, increase X by 1 instead.

alphaTraits.name: Swift Alpha
alphaTraits.description: While the Alpha remains alive, increase the Unit's Move by 1".

rules: A Unit may normally contain only one Alpha.
The Alpha's additional Wounds and personal defenses apply only to that Model. Any Unit-wide benefits end when the Alpha is removed.
Single-model Monsters generally use their own upgrade tables instead.
